claims.statement: Definitions used, from the dyadic triangular Hilbert preprint (Callens, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23232389): eq. (LI) for L_I; Proposition (finite reduction) Lambda(F) = |T(F)| + H(F) for step inputs at resolution N, with the trace form (eq. (trace)); Proposition (level) |T| + |L_000| <= 1 and sum over level-1 triples <= 1 at N = 2, giving Psi <= 4; Conjecture 7.1 (label conj:psi): H(F) + 3|T(F)| <= 3 prod ||F_v||_3 for all real inputs; for sign inputs every norm is 1 and the claim is Psi := H + 3|T| <= 3. The paper's own earlier exhaustive result: max R = 2 at resolution 2 (night lane 2026-10-07).

Definitions at N = 2 (n = 4) in units of 1/64: S_w(F) = w |T| + |L_0| + 2 sum over the 4 admissible level-1 triples |L_1|, with T = sum_ijk F0[i,j]F1[j,k]F2[k,i], level-0 Haar h = +1 on cells 0,1 and -1 on cells 2,3, level-1 Haar +1 on the left (even) cell, prefactor 2^l, weights 1/1/2 as stated; Psi <= 3 iff S_3 <= 192. Re-derived by the AI auditor with an evaluator that computes eq. (LI) as a literal integral in exact Fractions on a refined grid (no use of eq. (trace) or producer code): agrees with the producer's direct_value and with the independently authored h5_exact on 3000/3000 random sign inputs (w_T = 1, 3, 4), 3000/3000 Haar-free, 300/300 integer inputs; constant input T=1,H=0,R=1,Psi=3; seed g: T=1/2,H=3/2,R=2,Psi=3; N=1 exhaustive (2^12 inputs) max R = 1, max Psi = 3; mutation power: level-1 weight 1, odd XOR class, coarse Haar at level 1 each disagree with direct_value on 181, 155, 148 of 200 inputs.

The two reductions used by both producer enumerations are exact identities (proved in AUDIT.md section 3). (i) Sign fix: every term is trilinear in (F0,F1,F2), so F0 -> -F0 and F1 -> -F1 each negate every term and leave every |term| and every max over F2 unchanged; fixing F0[0,0] = F1[0,0] = +1 loses nothing and leaves 2^15 * 2^15 = 2^30 pairs. (ii) l1 reduction: for fixed (F0,F1) each term is <c_t,F2> (positive weights absorbed); max over F2 of sum_t |<c_t,F2>| = max over s of max over F2 of <sum_t s_t c_t, F2> (|a| = max_s s.a, swap of finite maxima) = max over s in {+-1}^6 of ||sum_t s_t c_t||_1, and s -> -s fixes s_0 = +1. Also confirmed empirically without either reduction by the auditor's third enumeration (DHP-C-0004) and by brute-force checks of (ii) against a literal max over all 2^16 F2 (Python 300 random pairs per mode x 5; C 200 + 100 + 100).

Producer enumerations over all 2^30 reduced (F0,F1) pairs, five modes (PSI, R, PLANT4, HF_R, HF_PSI): Python float32 kernel (psi_exhaust.py; matmul exact under a guard that every partial sum < 2^24; 160 chunks, contiguous F0 coverage [0, 32768)) and integer-only C (psi_exhaust.c, Gray-code order, no floating point). The two are independent implementations that SHARE the sign fix and the l1 reduction. For Psi: max S = 192 (Psi = 3 exactly), 0 pairs above 192, 4,608 pairs attain 192; the full histograms of max_{F2} S over 2^30 pairs are identical between the two enumerations in all five modes. Every per-F0 argmax (32,768 per mode) was rechecked by direct_value and by h5_exact (all agree) and the C argmax by a literal triple sum.

The auditor's third enumeration (gauge_enum.c, integer only, written independently) uses neither producer reduction: the exact diagonal sign gauge (F0,F1,F2) -> (D0 F0 D1, D1 F1 D2, D2 F2 D0) (order 2^11 on (F0,F1), free, kernel +-(I,I,I); representatives F0 with row 0 and column 0 all +1, F1 with row 0 all +1: 2^21 pairs) and a literal max over all 2^16 F2. 512 x its histogram equals the producer's C histogram and Python histogram bin by bin in all five modes; Psi: max 192, 0 pairs above 192, 9 canonical pairs at the maximum (x512 = 4,608). Reduction-free slices: for F0 codes 0,1,7000,12345,21845,30000,32767, all 2^15 F1 and a literal max over 2^16 F2: histograms equal the producer binary's in 35 of 35 (code, mode) cases (reported in AUDIT.md). Rebuild and rerun of both C halves: all output files byte-identical to data/c_enum/ and to the recorded sha256. Reproduced here: audit/compare.py output in audit/rerun_compare_hashcheck_output.txt.

Controls, run before the Psi numbers were counted. Positive: exhaustive max R = 2 reproduced (4,096 maximising pairs, auditor 8 x 512); Psi(constant) = 3; seed g gives H = 3/2, T = 1/2, R = 2, Psi = 3. Negative: Haar-free R reaches N + 1 = 3 (the bound of the level proposition), Haar-free Psi max 5 at the constant input with 7,356,928 pairs above 3 (auditor 14,369 x 512); planted weight w_T = 4 gives max 4 (S = 256) at the constant and 741,888 violating pairs in 7,360 F0 values, including values strictly between 3 and 4 (49/16 ... 7/2), so the search detects violations away from the constant input (auditor 1,449 x 512; confirmed at F0 code 1: 344 pairs above 192). A search that silently under-maximised would have been caught.

Kill criterion and cost: preregistered kill threshold 60 core-hours projected after a 1% sample; sample F0 in [0,328), Psi mode, 40.89 s, projecting 40.89 x 32768/328 / 3600 = 1.135 core-h (the file says 1.136, rounding) for Psi and about 5.7 core-h for all five Python modes; did not fire. Actual cost about 10 core-h or less (Python 25,964 s summed over 160 chunks on cores 4 and 5 shared with the C run; C about 80 min wall on the same two cores); the auditor's third enumeration about 0.8 core-h. Preregistration sha256 140a28ad...ae9be unchanged at start and end.

By-product found by the auditor, not claimed by the producer: exactly 9 x 2 x 2^11 = 36,864 of the 2^48 sign inputs attain Psi = 3 (18 maximising F2 summed over the 9 canonical pairs, times the orbit size 2^11), the auditor's count of maximisers (18 summed over 9 canonical pairs) is read off its own enumeration; it is not derived from the producer's 4,608. Computed from gauge_haar.json by compare.py.

HEADLINE. Over all 2^48 sign inputs F in {+-1}^48 at resolution N = 2, Psi = H + 3|T| satisfies Psi <= 3, with max exactly 3 (S = 192 in units 1/64), 0 violations; 4,608 of the 2^30 reduced pairs attain it. This is the sign-input, resolution-2 case of Conjecture 7.1 (conj:psi) of doi:10.5281/zenodo.23232389: our own conjecture; an exhaustive finite check (two producer enumerations plus an independent auditor enumeration); NOT progress on C*; nothing for real-valued inputs or N >= 3; no Lean or proof object for the 2^48 statement; compiler and hardware trusted (all runs on one machine). Tier C.

NOT done, recorded so the absences are explicit: no Lean or kernel certificate for the 2^48 statement; nothing for real-valued inputs or for N >= 3; the value of C* is untouched; the Python float32 kernel was not rerun by the auditor (cross-checked only through its histograms in summary.json, which equal 512 x the auditor's); compiler and hardware not checked; the repository guards and pytest tests/ were not run for this paper; no human audit.
